name: Summarization
description: Compress long passages into faithful summaries, teaching internal meaning extraction over surface copying.
probe_prompts: Summarize the following passage: Neural networks are computing systems inspired by biological neural networks. They consist of interconnected nodes that process information.
Summarize the following text: QLoRA allows parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large models on consumer GPUs by quantizing weights to 4-bit and injecting LoRA adapters.
